name: NEXFORM
summary:
NEXFORM (Xinyuanti) develops general-purpose embodied robots, key components and application solutions. The company is associated with technology transfer from a Zhejiang University robotics research team and describes a modular approach that can support multiple robot forms.

Its development strategy connects hardware, operational data and industry applications. Public materials identify hospitality and property management as important commercial settings, alongside work on remote operation and data collection. NEXFORM uses deployment experience to improve subsequent robot behavior, aiming to turn the repeated cycle of work, data gathering and model refinement into a practical foundation for broader embodied-intelligence applications.
